findings.title: Verify offline project resolution
findings.gap: Projects().get raises when a named project is absent; there is no project-create or conflict-recovery path.
findings.impact: Agent traces have no verified project destination.
findings.product_outcome: An existing or authorized newly created project resource is available as the trace destination.
findings.required_fix: Proof-only snapshot: execute current run_evaluation resource paths with fake SDK/network boundaries and classify unmet resolve-or-create criteria; application repair belongs to instrumentation.
acceptance_criteria: Both-existing reuses IDs with zero creates; both-missing creates project before stream; existing project with missing stream creates only its stream; repeated calls and create races converge by exact relookup.
Wrong ownership, ambiguous identity, 401/403, transport failures, and 5xx are blockers rather than absence; no speculative create or half-bound sink is permitted.
Fake SDK success is local app-code proof only and does not prove actual resource creation or fresh cloud Agent Stream receipt.

scenarios.trigger: Execute actual eval_runner.run_evaluation with fake Projects, AgentStreams, and SplunkAOLogger for both existing, both missing, existing project with missing stream, repeated calls, project and stream create races, wrong ownership, ambiguous lookups, and lookup/create authorization or outage outcomes.
scenarios.expected_signals: Exact ordered resource lookups and minimal creates; verified project ownership; no speculative create after failed lookup; no logger initialization on setup failure; termination on completed work.
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Tests execute current source and inspect call counts, resource identity, project ownership, and sink lifecycle. Missing create or conflict recovery is Not Working; application code is unchanged. No live service is required, and real cloud creation or stream receipt stays unproven.

scenarios.trigger: Resolve existing fake project and stream, initialize fake SplunkAOLogger, then inject independent errors from start_trace, add_llm_span, conclude, and flush while executing actual eval_runner.run_evaluation
scenarios.expected_signals: One initialized fake logger per case, the injected post-initialization error propagates, and exactly one terminate call from actual finally; no live provider or cloud calls
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Durable executed evidence records each independent fault point, injected exception, initialization count, and terminate count. Every case initializes once and terminates exactly once while preserving error propagation. Resource-setup failures with zero initialized loggers cannot substitute for this post-initialization lifecycle proof.

scenarios.trigger: Only when separately authorized, run original eval_runner.run_evaluation with the installed SDK and fake external transport/resource responses; capture real exported model spans and assess whether an actual coordinated workflow exists.
scenarios.expected_signals: The existing evaluation_answer model operation with applicable GenAI fields and safe bounded content; correct terminal lifecycle and no duplicate operations. A workflow span is expected only after applicability and its actual creator are established.
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Source call sites remain unchanged. Actual SDK span emission is captured rather than fabricated by SDK mocks; trace-envelope creation alone proves no workflow operation. Known parameters, usage, content bounds and error/cancellation lifecycle are verified only if executed; resource-only success and canonical binding leave this optional GenAI coverage unproven.
